tldr: 台股週一（8/10）大漲702點收44,928點、攻上本波反彈高峰，台積電漲10元至2,380元，記憶體族群強攻。
台積電7月營收4,675.8億元、年增44.7%再創新高，前七月累計逼近2.87兆元，AI 晶片需求續熱。
金融業亮眼：13家金控上半年賺4,408億創同期新高；8月高股息ETF除息潮，00878配息1.01元創掛牌新高。
台灣7月CPI年增2.54%、連3月站上2%通膨警戒線，央行維持偏緊立場。
國際上，油價8/10因荷莫茲海峽疑慮勁揚約5%、美10年期殖利率升至4.705%，市場為本週美國CPI預作準備。

items.title_zh: 台股大漲702點收44,928 攻反彈新高 台積電、記憶體領軍
items.title_en: Taiex surges 702 points to 44,928, a fresh rebound high as TSMC and memory lead
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週一（8/10）勁揚702.85點、收44,928.76點，成交量8,473億元，盤中一度重返45,000點大關後拉回，改寫本波反彈新高。台積電上漲10元至2,380元，記憶體族群更成盤面主角，南亞科、華邦電受惠 AI 與 HBM 需求回溫亮燈漲停，帶動漲勢由權值龍頭擴散至中小型類股。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index climbed 702.85 points on Monday (Aug 10) to close at 44,928.76 on turnover of NT$847.3bn, reclaiming the 45,000 level intraday before easing back and marking a new high for the current rebound. TSMC rose NT$10 to NT$2,380 while memory names dominated, with Nanya Technology and Winbond locking limit-up on resurgent AI and HBM demand, broadening the rally beyond the foundry leader.

items.title_zh: 「台積電條款」8/10上路 證交所放寬注意股門檻
items.title_en: "TSMC clause" takes effect Aug 10 as TWSE eases attention-stock thresholds
items.summary_zh: 證交所自週一起實施調整後的注意股與處置門檻，市場稱為「台積電條款」，避免單一超高價權值股因股價基期過高而頻頻觸發監視機制、扭曲指數連動的監控標準。放寬後的門檻旨在使交易規則更合乎比例原則，因應台積電權重攀升，降低技術性處置措施干擾市場龍頭正常交易的風險。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's exchange implemented adjusted "attention stock" disposal criteria from Monday, dubbed the "TSMC clause," to prevent a single ultra-high-priced heavyweight from repeatedly tripping surveillance triggers and distorting index-linked monitoring. The relaxed thresholds aim to keep trading rules proportionate as TSMC's weighting climbs, reducing the risk of technical disposal measures that could otherwise disrupt orderly trading in the market's dominant name.

items.title_zh: 台積電7月營收4,675.8億創新高 前七月逼近2.87兆
items.title_en: TSMC July revenue hits record NT$467.58bn, seven-month sales near NT$2.87tn
items.summary_zh: 台積電公布7月合併營收4,675.8億元，月增5.6%、年增44.7%，續創單月歷史新高；累計今年前七月合併營收達2兆8,720.64億元、年增37.0%。雲端服務商持續擴充 AI 基礎建設，帶動先進製程 GPU 與 AI ASIC 需求強勁，使台積電2026年成長動能明顯優於先前預期，也支撐其全年營收與資本支出上修的基調。
items.summary_en: TSMC reported July consolidated revenue of NT$467.58bn, up 5.6% from June and 44.7% year-on-year, setting a fresh monthly record. Cumulative revenue for the first seven months reached NT$2.8721tn, up 37.0% year-on-year, underscoring how cloud providers' relentless AI infrastructure buildout continues to drive demand for advanced-node GPUs and AI ASICs and keeps the foundry's 2026 growth trajectory well ahead of earlier expectations.

items.title_zh: 記憶體族群強攻 AI與HBM需求回溫點火
items.title_en: Memory group storms higher as AI and HBM demand revives
items.summary_zh: 記憶體類股領漲週一盤面，南亞科、華邦電雙雙亮燈漲停，反映 AI 伺服器與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求回升，加上傳統 DRAM 供給趨緊。這波強勢使盤面主流由台積電擴散開來，顯示 AI 資本支出循環正拉動更廣泛的台灣半導體供應鏈，從記憶體廠延伸至封裝測試業者，族群輪動更趨全面。
items.summary_en: Memory-chip stocks led Monday's advance, with Nanya Technology and Winbond hitting limit-up as the sector rode a rebound in AI-server and high-bandwidth-memory (HBM) demand alongside tightening conventional DRAM supply. The strength broadened the market's leadership beyond TSMC, signaling that the AI capital-spending cycle is now pulling in a wider slice of Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain, from memory makers to packaging and testing houses.

items.title_zh: 13家金控上半年賺4,408億 創歷史同期新高
items.title_en: 13 listed financial holding companies earn record NT$440.8bn in first half
items.summary_zh: 台灣13家上市金控2026年上半年合計稅後盈餘達4,408.75億元，較去年同期大增約101%、幾近倍增，刷新歷史同期最高紀錄。強勁獲利主要受惠台股交投熱絡與資本市場蓬勃，富邦金、國泰金領先群雄；成績凸顯股市走強已全面反映至金控旗下銀行、證券與壽險子公司的獲利表現。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's 13 listed financial holding companies posted combined after-tax profit of NT$440.875bn for the first half of 2026, roughly doubling (+101%) from a year earlier and setting an all-time first-half record. The surge was driven by buoyant stock-market trading and thriving capital markets, with Fubon and Cathay leading; the results highlight how equity-market strength has flowed through to bank, securities and insurance subsidiaries across the sector.

items.title_zh: 六大壽險上半年賺1,746億 年增384%投資收益爆發
items.title_en: Top six life insurers earn NT$174.7bn in H1, up 384% on investment gains
items.summary_zh: 台灣六大壽險上半年合計獲利1,746.68億元、年增384%，受惠股市走熱帶動投資收益大增。富邦人壽賺555.8億元、年增126%，南山人壽308.69億元、年增114%，台灣人壽102.76億元、年增42%。此波反彈為長期受避險成本與利率波動所苦的壽險業帶來明顯轉機，股市資本利得成為左右獲利的關鍵變數。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's six largest life insurers reported combined first-half profit of NT$174.668bn, a 384% year-on-year jump, as a hot stock market lifted investment income. Fubon Life earned NT$55.58bn (+126%), Nan Shan Life NT$30.87bn (+114%) and Taiwan Life NT$10.28bn (+42%). The rebound marks a sharp turnaround for an industry that had wrestled with hedging costs and rate volatility, with equity gains now the dominant swing factor in earnings.

items.title_zh: 8月ETF配息季開跑 國泰00878配1.01元創掛牌新高
items.title_en: August ETF dividend season kicks off; Cathay 00878 pays record NT$1.01
items.summary_zh: 國泰永續高股息（00878）本季每受益權單位配發1.01元，較上季0.66元增加約53%，首度突破1元、寫下掛牌以來新高，換算年化殖利率近12.4%，除息日為8月18日。創高配息反映成分股股利收益穩健，也顯示高股息ETF為爭取台灣領息族資金，配息競爭日趨白熱化。
items.summary_en: Cathay Sustainability High Dividend ETF (00878) declared a quarterly distribution of NT$1.01 per unit, up about 53% from NT$0.66 previously—its first time above NT$1 and an all-time high since listing—implying an annualized yield near 12.4% with an Aug 18 ex-date. The record payout reflects strong underlying dividend income and intensifying competition among high-yield ETFs for Taiwan's income-focused retail investors.

items.title_zh: 8月19檔台股ETF接力除息 部分殖利率逾16%
items.title_en: 19 Taiwan ETFs line up August ex-dividends, some yielding over 16%
items.summary_zh: 8月共有19檔台股ETF陸續除息，涵蓋高股息與半導體主題，多檔預估年化殖利率達兩位數，00881約18%、00929逾16%。理財顧問提醒領息族，選擇時不應只看帳面殖利率，更要留意總報酬、淨值走勢與各基金的填息能力，避免單純追逐最高配息而忽略整體投資成效。
items.summary_en: A total of 19 Taiwan-listed ETFs are staggering ex-dividend dates through August, spanning high-dividend and semiconductor themes, with several offering estimated annualized yields well into double digits—00881 around 18% and 00929 above 16%. Advisers caution income investors to look beyond headline yields to total return, NAV trends and each fund's ability to close the dividend gap, rather than chasing the highest distribution alone.

items.title_zh: 遺贈稅修法草案 死亡前2年贈與特定親屬併入遺產課稅
items.title_en: Estate-tax bill would fold two-year pre-death gifts to family into taxable estate
items.summary_zh: 行政院通過的遺產及贈與稅法部分條文修正草案，明定被繼承人死亡前2年內贈與特定親屬（配偶、各順序繼承人及其配偶）之財產，須併入遺產總額課徵遺產稅，並釐清遺產稅額計算方式，以防杜臨終前移轉財產規避遺產稅。此修正收緊世代財富移轉規劃，使大額家族贈與的時點成為高資產家庭的關鍵考量。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's draft amendment to the Estate and Gift Tax Act, approved by the Executive Yuan, would require certain gifts made within two years before death—to a spouse, heirs of each order and their spouses—to be added back into the deceased's taxable estate, clarifying the calculation method to curb estate-tax avoidance through late-stage transfers. The change tightens intergenerational-transfer planning and makes timing of large family gifts a key consideration for high-net-worth households.

items.title_zh: 2026遺產稅級距隨CPI上漲12.42%調整 贈與稅免稅額維持244萬
items.title_en: 2026 estate-tax brackets widen on 12.42% CPI rise; gift-tax exemption held at NT$2.44m
items.summary_zh: 因累計CPI達12.42%的法定調整門檻，2026年遺產稅各課稅級距金額調高，減輕資產隨通膨成長者的累進稅負；而年度贈與稅免稅額則維持244萬元不變。此次校準小幅降低實質遺產稅負擔並保留既有贈與額度，使分年生前移轉等結構化策略在財富傳承規劃上仍具吸引力。
items.summary_en: Because cumulative CPI reached the statutory 12.42% adjustment threshold, Taiwan raised the monetary boundaries of the 2026 estate-tax brackets, easing the progressive-rate impact for estates that grew with inflation, while the annual gift-tax exemption stays unchanged at NT$2.44m. The recalibration modestly lowers effective estate-tax burdens and preserves existing gifting allowances, keeping structured lifetime-transfer strategies attractive for wealth succession.

items.title_zh: 台灣7月CPI年增2.54% 連3月站上2%通膨警戒線
items.title_en: Taiwan July CPI up 2.54%, third month above the 2% alert line
items.summary_zh: 台灣7月消費者物價指數年增2.54%，連續第3個月高於央行2%的通膨警戒線，核心CPI亦年增2.38%，顯示物價壓力具韌性。此一僵固性使央行政策走向備受關注，法人預期短期內央行仍將維持相對偏緊的貨幣政策立場，而非隨即轉向寬鬆，即使全球利率預期正在移動。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's consumer price index rose 2.54% year-on-year in July, staying above the central bank's 2% inflation-warning threshold for a third straight month, while core CPI climbed 2.38%, signaling sticky price pressure. The persistence keeps the central bank's policy path in focus, with analysts expecting it to maintain a relatively tight monetary stance rather than ease near-term, even as global rate expectations shift.

items.title_zh: 央行上修2026 CPI 通膨警戒線受考驗 生產端物價飆升
items.title_en: Central bank lifts 2026 CPI forecast toward alert line as producer prices soar
items.summary_zh: 台灣央行上修2026年CPI預測，逼近通膨警戒線；7月生產者物價指數年增16.94%、出口物價年增19.71%，主因電子產品、石油及化學材料價格上揚。上修凸顯成本端壓力沿供應鏈傳導，並強化市場預期央行將維持審慎、偏緊的政策姿態，同時密切觀察AI供應鏈需求、美國經貿政策及主要央行動向。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank raised its 2026 CPI projection, testing the inflation-warning line, as July producer prices surged 16.94% year-on-year and export prices jumped 19.71%, driven by electronics, petroleum and chemicals. The upgrade underscores building cost-side pressure feeding through the supply chain and reinforces expectations that policymakers will hold a cautious, tightening-biased posture while watching AI-chain demand, US trade policy and global central-bank moves.

items.title_zh: CPI倒數 科技股先漲一步 台媒聚焦本週關鍵通膨數據
items.title_en: Tech leads Wall Street higher into CPI countdown, Taiwan media report
items.summary_zh: 在美國7月CPI（台北時間8/12）公布前，台灣市場評論指出科技股提前表態走揚，並將此次通膨數據與週四PPI視為檢驗夏季多頭能否延續的第一道關卡。報導強調Fed面臨勞動市場轉弱與通膨黏著並存的少見兩難，使9月利率決策處於微妙平衡，全球風險情緒對數據高度敏感。
items.summary_en: Ahead of Wednesday's key US July CPI release (Aug 12 Taipei time), Taiwan market commentary flagged technology stocks running up in advance, framing the inflation print—and Thursday's PPI—as the first major test of whether the summer rally can extend. Coverage stressed the Fed's unusual dilemma of a softening labor market alongside sticky inflation, keeping the September rate decision finely balanced and global risk sentiment sensitive to the data.

items.title_zh: 8月美股8大關鍵指標 牽動Fed降息或升息之爭
items.title_en: August's eight macro catalysts frame Fed cut-vs-hike debate
items.summary_zh: 台灣券商整理的8月美股財經行事曆，點名CPI、非農到PCE等8項關鍵指標，凸顯市場對Fed今年究竟偏向降息或重啟升息的分歧。專文強調預期已明顯兩極、升息機率重新被納入定價，並提醒投資人將每項數據都視為潛在的波動觸發點，而非假設寬鬆路徑已定。
items.summary_en: A Taiwan brokerage rundown of August's US financial calendar highlighted eight key indicators—from CPI and payrolls to PCE—as markets debate whether the Fed leans toward a cut or a fresh hike this year. The guide underscored how divided expectations have become, with rate-hike odds creeping back into pricing, and urged investors to treat each release as a potential volatility trigger rather than assume a settled easing path.

items.title_zh: 油價8/10勁揚約5% 荷莫茲海峽僵局未解（2026-08-10）
items.title_en: Oil jumps ~5% on Aug 10 as Strait of Hormuz standoff drags on (2026-08-10)
items.summary_zh: 國際油價週一大漲約5%，因市場對美伊短期內達成重啟荷莫茲海峽通行協議的希望降溫；全球約兩成石油正常經此運輸。美國WTI收在約82.13美元、布蘭特約87.72美元。伊朗重申須美國解除航運封鎖與制裁才願鬆綁該咽喉水道，青年運動與油輪相關事件再添風險溢價。
items.summary_en: Crude prices surged about 5% Monday as hopes faded for a near-term US–Iran deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, through which roughly a fifth of the world's oil normally flows. US WTI settled near $82.13 and Brent around $87.72 a barrel. Iran reiterated it would only ease the chokepoint if Washington lifted its shipping blockade and sanctions, while Houthi and tanker incidents added a fresh risk premium.

items.title_en: Asia-Pacific stocks close broadly higher on Aug 10, Nikkei up 2.1% (2026-08-10)
items.summary_zh: 亞洲股市週一走揚，日本日經225指數領漲2.1%、收在66,970點。香港恒生指數受醫療與非必需消費類股走強帶動上漲約1%，南韓Kospi漲0.65%、Kosdaq勁揚，澳洲ASX 200則小跌0.3%。區域漲勢反映風險胃納仍具韌性，儘管投資人在美國通膨數據密集公布的一週前轉趨審慎。
items.summary_en: Asian equities advanced Monday, led by Japan's Nikkei 225, which climbed 2.1% to close at 66,970. Hong Kong's Hang Seng rose about 1% on strength in healthcare and consumer cyclicals, South Korea's Kospi added 0.65% and the Kosdaq surged, while Australia's ASX 200 slipped 0.3%. The regional gains reflected resilient risk appetite even as investors turned cautious ahead of a heavy week of US inflation data.

items.title_zh: 美10年期公債殖利率升至4.705% 油價走高、CPI在即（2026-08-10）
items.title_en: 10-year Treasury yield climbs to 4.705% as oil gains and CPI looms (2026-08-10)
items.summary_zh: 美國10年期公債殖利率週初上升逾4個基點至4.705%，2年期亦升逾3個基點至4.241%，因油價攀升推升通膨疑慮、投資人為數據密集的一週預作準備。CPI將於週中公布、PPI緊接在後，交易員押注9月升息機率約五成，凸顯利率前景已明顯朝升息風險重新定價。
items.summary_en: The US 10-year Treasury yield rose more than four basis points to 4.705% at the start of the week, and the 2-year added over three basis points to 4.241%, as climbing oil prices lifted inflation concerns and investors braced for a data-heavy stretch. With CPI due midweek and PPI to follow, traders were pricing roughly a 50% chance of a September rate hike, underscoring how sharply the rate outlook has repriced toward tightening risk.

items.title_zh: 金價守在7週高點約4,357美元 通膨數據在即（2026-08-10）
items.title_en: Gold holds near seven-week high around $4,357 as inflation data looms (2026-08-10)
items.summary_zh: 現貨黃金週一小升約0.4%至每盎司約4,356.79美元，逼近上週美國非農意外疲弱、市場重燃Fed按兵不動預期後所創的7週高點；美國黃金期貨漲0.4%至約4,416美元。買方在本週CPI與PPI公布前續抱部位，金價夾在殖利率走高與中東緊張避險需求之間拉鋸。
items.summary_en: Spot gold edged up about 0.4% to around $4,356.79 an ounce on Monday, hovering near a seven-week peak reached after last week's unexpectedly weak US payrolls revived expectations the Fed would stay on hold. US gold futures added 0.4% to about $4,416. Buyers held positions ahead of the week's CPI and PPI releases, with bullion caught between firmer yields and safe-haven demand from Middle East tensions.
